verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no Mastra capability to export user data in open formats. Mastra Cloud is a hosted platform, so a data-export path is a fair question for this product. The nearest items are adjacent and earn no credit. Running locally and deploying to Vercel, Netlify or Cloudflare is code and deployment portability, not data export. Storage for memory and workflow state is described without any export mechanism or format.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
